entities.summary: Reese Wynans is an American keyboard player, who has performed and toured with various artists since he entered the scene in 1967, most notably as a member of Double Trouble and progressive rock band Captain Beyond. In 2015, he was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of Double Trouble.
